# Wikipedia test fixtures

The HTML files in this directory are rendered pages from the English Wikipedia
(<https://en.wikipedia.org>), used unchanged as parser test fixtures. Their content is licensed under
[CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/); authorship is recorded in each page's history,
reachable from the revision link below.

Each file is named after its revision id and was downloaded with `scripts/fetch_fixture.py`.
